meta.flag: illustrative-reverify — design documentation, not a validated medical device (README §5.6)

Question.purpose: Immutable bank-item definition seeded from question-bank.json. Carries the question text, domain (DOM-NNN ref), response options with signed pillar/reservoir weight vectors, dependency DAG (show_if / skip_if / triggers / validated_by), applicability constraints (sex, age_min/max, life_stage, personas), cadence (Core/quarterly/annual/biennial/once/on-trigger), refresh class (static/slow/periodic/dynamic/event), and priority 1–5. A Question record never changes after publish; breaking changes produce a new version in QuestionBank.

stories.want: the app to only show me questions that are relevant to my sex, age, and current persona
stories.soThat: I am not asked about female-specific conditions when I am male, or about menopause when I am 28
acceptance: Given a Question with applicability.sex=['female'] and applicability.age_min=40, When the Question Service evaluates eligibility for a 32-year-old male patient, Then the question is excluded from the candidate set
Given a Question with applicability.personas=['pregnancy'], When a patient with no pregnancy persona is evaluated, Then the question is gated out regardless of other criteria
Given a COR-001 (age) question with applicability.sex=['all'] and age_min=0, When any patient is evaluated, Then the question is always eligible
Given a Question with gated=true, When prerequisites are not yet satisfied, Then the question is withheld even if all other applicability filters pass
edge: Patient has persona=['menopause','elderly'] — question requires only persona=['elderly']; must be included (partial-set match, not strict equality)
age_max=120 edge case: question has no effective upper age gate and must serve centenarian users

stories.want: each Response posting to apply the signed pillar and reservoir weight vectors defined on the matching Question response option
stories.soThat: answering 'BMI 25–29.9 (overweight)' correctly raises MET, CV, BCM pillar risk scores and inflates the adiposity and glycemic_burden reservoirs by the declared magnitudes
acceptance: Given a Question Q_CORE_BMI and a response label '25–29.9 (overweight)', When POST /responses is called with that answer, Then pillar deltas {MET:+0.12, CV:+0.08, BCM:+0.06} and reservoir inflows {adiposity:+0.10, glycemic_burden:+0.06} are written to the Response record
Given direction='decrease_risk' and non-empty reservoir delta, When the delta is applied, Then the reservoir level decreases (negative inflow)
Given a response with empty pillars {} and empty reservoirs {}, When applied, Then no pillar or reservoir record is mutated
Given the same response posted twice with the same idempotency-key, When the second call arrives, Then it returns HTTP 200 with the original Response and no duplicate deltas are applied
edge: Response label not found in the Question's declared options — service must reject with 422 Unprocessable Entity, not silently drop

stories.want: a crude item flagging low mood to automatically surface the PHQ-9 validated PRO instrument
stories.soThat: a single-item screen ('How often have you felt down, depressed, or hopeless?') triggers a full validated questionnaire that is scored separately and feeds MCS with proper clinical weight
acceptance: Given a Question with dependencies.validated_by pointing to a PRO instrument, When a patient response matches the trigger threshold (e.g. 'More than half the days' or 'Nearly every day'), Then the DependencyEngine enqueues the validated PRO as the next question set
Given the PHQ-9 is already completed within the current cadence window, When the low-mood crude item fires its trigger, Then the PRO is NOT re-administered (idempotent within cadence)
Given the trigger fires for a patient on a betablocker persona with HR-confounded metrics, Then the PRO trigger proceeds normally (betablocker confounder applies to wearable HR, not PRO instruments)

Given the PRO has been administered, When all 9 PHQ-9 items are answered, Then a composite clinical score is computed and written as a single Response with MCS pillar delta and allostatic_load reservoir inflow
edge: PRO instrument itself has a validated_by dependency (e.g. PHQ-9 score ≥15 triggers urgent escalation pathway via Governance) — the engine must recurse the dependency DAG one level

stories.want: static answers (sex, date of birth, family history) to never be asked again once recorded
stories.soThat: I am not repeatedly prompted for foundational data that cannot change
acceptance: Given a Question with refresh='static' and a Response exists for this patient, When next-question is called, Then that Question is excluded from the candidate set permanently
Given a Question with refresh='periodic' and cadence='quarterly', When the last Response is older than 90 days, Then the question re-enters the eligible set for re-asking

Given a Question with refresh='dynamic' (e.g. current weight), When the patient's wearable stream provides an updated value within the cadence window, Then the question is suppressed (auto-answered from wearable, not re-prompted)
Given a Question with cadence='on-trigger' and its trigger has not fired, When next-question is evaluated, Then the question is not included in the normal rotation
edge: Patient explicitly requests to correct a static answer (e.g. a mistyped sex or date of birth) — system must support a supervised override that creates a new Response with a correction_reason field while retaining the audit trail of the original

columns.name: bank_version_id

columns.name: domain_code

columns.name: cadence

columns.name: responses_json

columns.name: unlocks_json
columns.note: array of ref strings this answer may unlock

columns.name: axis_tags_json

columns.name: deprecated_at

table.notes: Seeded from question-bank.json on first deploy and on each bank version bump. Records are append-only; deprecation is soft (deprecated_at). The responses_json holds the full weight vector for all options — ResponseScorer reads these at answer-time to compute pillar/reservoir deltas.

invariants: A question is only surfaced when all prerequisite refs have a non-null Response for this patient (prerequisites_json satisfied)
A question is excluded when any applicability constraint fails: sex mismatch, patient age outside [age_min, age_max], or required persona absent from patient's persona set
A question with refresh='static' is never re-asked once a Response exists for this patient, except via a supervised correction flow with audit trail
A question with cadence='on-trigger' is only enqueued when its show_if condition fires or a trigger from another question matches
validated_by escalation must fire synchronously when the response label matches the trigger predicate — it cannot be silently dropped
Question records are immutable after publish; pillar/reservoir weights may only change by issuing a new bank version via QuestionBank

QuestionBank.purpose: Versioned container for the full set of Question definitions. A bank version represents a coherent snapshot of the full question set, their weight calibrations, and the dependency DAG. The active bank version governs which questions are served; multiple versions may coexist during staged rollouts. Version bumps are gated by the validation harness (D17) before promotion to active. Provides the admin surface for clinician/editorial review of question content and weights.

stories.want: to promote a new bank version through a staging gate before it affects live patients
stories.soThat: weight calibration errors or question-text regressions are caught before they alter production scores
acceptance: Given a draft bank version v1.2 with updated MND domain weights, When the validation harness runs the calibration suite, Then the version may only be promoted to status='active' if all harness gates pass
Given a version is promoted to active, When next-question is called for any patient, Then only questions belonging to the active bank version are candidates
Given an active version v1.1 and a newly promoted v1.2, When v1.2 is promoted, Then v1.1 status transitions to 'superseded' and is retained for audit replay
Given a bank version in status='draft', When a clinician edits question text or weights, Then only the draft version is mutated; active version remains unchanged
edge: Rollback scenario: if v1.2 is found to produce systematically depressed CV scores post-promotion, admin must be able to reinstate v1.1 as active without data loss

stories.want: to record which bank version was active when each Response was captured
stories.soThat: historical score replay uses the weight calibration that was live at the time, not today's calibration
acceptance: Given a Response is posted, When it is persisted, Then it carries a bank_version_id FK referencing the bank version active at that moment
Given a score replay is requested for a date 6 months ago, When the engine reconstructs the pillar deltas, Then it uses the bank version that was active on that date, not the current active version

Given two bank versions with different pillar weights for COR-004 (weight), When a Response from v1.1 is replayed under v1.2, Then the system warns that cross-version replay may diverge from original score
Given admin-constants API is called, When it returns the active model version, Then it includes the active bank_version_id alongside the scoring constants version
edge: A question ref exists in v1.1 but is deprecated (removed) in v1.2; historical Responses referencing that ref must remain valid even though the question is absent from the current bank

stories.want: a full audit trail of every change made to any bank version
stories.soThat: regulatory review can trace exactly which question weights were in effect at any point in time
acceptance: Given any mutation to a draft bank version, When persisted, Then an audit log entry is appended recording the editor identity, timestamp, changed field, old value, and new value
Given a bank version is promoted, When the promotion event fires, Then an immutable audit record is written with the approver identity and validation-harness run ID
Given get-model-version is called, When responding, Then it returns the active bank version, its promotion timestamp, and the approver identity
Given a bank version is superseded, When queried by ID, Then it is still fully retrievable including all question definitions at that version
edge: Bank version imported from an external source (e.g. question-bank.json v1.1 seed) must also carry a provenance record with source file hash and import timestamp

table.name: question_bank

columns.name: source_file_hash
columns.note: SHA-256 of seed JSON if imported

columns.name: validation_run_id
columns.note: FK into validation-harness run that gated this version

columns.name: superseded_at
columns.note: set when replaced by a later active version

table.notes: At most one row may have status='active' at any time (enforced by partial unique index WHERE status='active'). The question table FKs into this table. Audit mutations are written to the append-only audit store, not this table.

invariants: Exactly one QuestionBank row has status='active' at any point in time; enforced by DB partial unique constraint
A bank version may only transition draft→staging→active; it may never regress from active to draft (only rollback by re-promoting a prior version)
Promotion to active requires a passing validation_run_id — the harness gate cannot be bypassed (D17)
All Question rows referencing this bank_version_id are immutable once the bank version leaves draft status
Historical Responses retaining a FK to a superseded bank version remain valid and queryable; the superseded version must never be hard-deleted

Response.purpose: Time-series record of a patient's answer to a single Question at a specific point in time. Stores the raw answer value, the matched response label, and the pillar/reservoir deltas that were applied at the time of posting. Supports idempotent posting (idempotency-key), immutable once written, and carries the bank_version_id that governed weight computation. Forms the primary event log for the LIFE stream; drives score recomputation and may trigger validated PRO enqueuing via the DependencyEngine.

stories.want: my answer to be applied to my PureScore immediately after I submit it
stories.soThat: I can see the impact of my lifestyle disclosure on my score in real time
acceptance: Given a POST /responses body with patient_id, question_ref, answer_label, and idempotency-key, When processed, Then a Response row is persisted with applied_pillar_deltas and applied_reservoir_deltas matching the Question's weight vector for that label
Given the Response is persisted, When the ScoreRecomputed event fires, Then GET /score reflects the updated PureScore within 5 seconds

Given the answer_label is 'Nearly every day' on a low-mood crude item with validated_by trigger, When the Response is written, Then the DependencyEngine enqueues the PHQ-9 PRO and next-question returns the first PHQ-9 item
Given the same idempotency-key is sent a second time, When the second POST arrives, Then HTTP 200 is returned with the original Response body and no second delta is applied to pillars or reservoirs
edge: Network retry delivers a duplicate POST after the original committed — idempotency-key must prevent double-scoring even under concurrent requests (use SELECT FOR UPDATE or upsert with conflict target)

stories.want: to replay historical responses using the bank version that was active when each response was captured
stories.soThat: a weight-calibration upgrade does not retroactively alter a patient's historical score trajectory
acceptance: Given a Response captured under bank version v1.1, When a score replay is requested for that date, Then the engine reads the pillar/reservoir weight vectors from the v1.1 question definitions, not from the current active version
Given a Response has applied_pillar_deltas already persisted, When replaying, Then the engine can use the stored deltas directly rather than re-looking up the Question (snapshot fidelity)
Given a score timeline is requested via get-score with a date range, When returned, Then each data point includes the bank_version_id that governed its computation
Given a PRO instrument Response (composite score), When posted, Then the Response record stores the composite_score field alongside the individual item answers for audit
edge: A bank version bump changes the weight for a question that a patient answered 3 months ago; the historical Response must retain its original deltas unchanged while new Responses use the new weights

stories.want: periodic and dynamic questions to be refreshed when my answer is stale
stories.soThat: my score reflects my current lifestyle rather than answers I gave a year ago
acceptance: Given a Response for a refresh='periodic' cadence='quarterly' question older than 90 days, When next-question is evaluated, Then that question re-enters the eligible candidate set

Given a Response for a refresh='dynamic' question (e.g. current weight) and a wearable stream provides a fresher value within cadence, When next-question is evaluated, Then the question is auto-answered from the wearable and not re-prompted
Given a Response for a refresh='static' question (e.g. sex), When next-question is evaluated at any future date, Then that question is never re-prompted except via a supervised correction flow

Given a refresh='event' question (on-trigger cadence) where the trigger has re-fired (e.g. new pregnancy life-stage detected), When next-question is evaluated, Then the question re-enters the eligible set despite a prior Response existing
edge: Patient answers a 'quarterly' question on day 1, then on day 45 a wearable anomaly re-triggers the on-trigger variant of the same underlying question — the system must treat the on-trigger cadence variant as a distinct eligibility path, not blocked by the periodic Response

stories.want: every Response to carry an immutable audit record of what weight was applied and why
stories.soThat: a regulatory audit can reconstruct any patient's score delta from first principles
acceptance: Given any Response is persisted, When queried, Then it exposes patient_id, question_ref, bank_version_id, answer_label, raw_value, applied_pillar_deltas, applied_reservoir_deltas, answered_at, and idempotency_key
Given a Response is posted, When persisted, Then no field except soft-delete flags may ever be mutated (all changes create new Responses with correction_reason)
Given a PRO trigger fires alongside a Response, When the audit record is written, Then it includes triggered_pro_ref so the escalation chain is traceable
Given get-explanation is called for a pillar, When it traces contributing Responses, Then each Response is cited by ref, answered_at, and the delta it contributed
edge: Patient withdraws consent mid-session — all Responses must be soft-deleted (anonymised) but the aggregate deltas already applied to the score must remain traceable in the audit store under a pseudonymous token

indexes: INDEX (triggered_pro_ref) WHERE triggered_pro_ref IS NOT NULL
INDEX (deleted_at) WHERE deleted_at IS NOT NULL
table.notes: TIME-SERIES table — one row per patient answer event; never UPDATE after insert (immutable). For wearable auto-answered questions, source='wearable_auto' and raw_value holds the aggregated metric. applied_pillar_deltas and applied_reservoir_deltas are snapshot-frozen at insert time so historical replay is self-contained. The composite_score column is populated only for validated PRO instruments (PHQ-9, GAD-7, etc.).

invariants: A Response row is immutable after insert; no UPDATE is permitted except setting deleted_at for consent withdrawal
idempotency_key must be globally unique; duplicate POSTs with the same key return the existing record without re-applying deltas
applied_pillar_deltas and applied_reservoir_deltas are frozen at insert time from the Question's weight vector; they must not be recalculated on read
A Response may only be created for a question_ref that was eligible for this patient at answered_at — the QuestionService validates applicability and prerequisites before accepting a POST
If validated_by trigger fires, triggered_pro_ref must be set and the PRO must be atomically enqueued in the same transaction as the Response insert
Static-answer corrections require a non-null correction_reason and supersedes_response_id pointing to the original; the original is never deleted
